dialogue.origin: （こんにちは。本日はお時間を作っていただきありがとうございます。お時間になったら始めさせていただきます。よろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.content: (Hello. Thank you for making time for our session today. We will begin at the scheduled time. I look forward to working with you.)

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Hello. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員です。相談に来ていただきありがとうございます。はじめに、年齢と性別、相談内容を教えていただけますか。
dialogue.content: Hello. I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 44歳女性会社の同僚がキツくて困っています
dialogue.content: I'm a 44-year-old woman, and I'm having trouble with a difficult coworker.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。職場の方と合わないと仕事に行くのもきついですよね。
dialogue.content: I see. It must be tough to go to work when you don't get along with someone there.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。部署は違う同じ歳の女性で、稀に見るキツい性格なんです
dialogue.content: That's right. She's a woman my age in a different department, and she has an unusually harsh personality.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。どのようなところが「キツイ」性格だと感じられてるんですか？
dialogue.content: I see. What aspects of her personality make you feel she's 'harsh'?

dialogue.origin: いつも口調がかなりキツく、気分が良くないと返事もしてくれなくて、たまに嫌な事を言われるんです
dialogue.content: Her tone is always quite harsh, and if she's not in a good mood, she won't even reply. Sometimes she says unpleasant things to me.

dialogue.origin: それは嫌な気持ちになりますね・・。返事もしてくれないと、不安にもなりますよね。
dialogue.content: That must be upsetting... And when she doesn't reply, it must make you feel anxious as well.

dialogue.origin: 「嫌な事」とはどのようなことを言われるのですか。もしよろしければ教えていただけますか。
dialogue.content: What kind of 'unpleasant things' does she say? If you're comfortable, could you tell me?

dialogue.origin: 中小企業で、昼ごはんは、女性、男性別れて食べる部屋があり、そこでわりと皆さん無言なんですが、話をしようと何か発言しても、話を広げず、YESＮＯでしか答えてくれない
dialogue.content: It's a small to medium-sized company, and there are separate rooms for men and women to eat lunch. It's usually quiet in there, but even if I try to start a conversation, she doesn't elaborate and only answers with 'yes' or 'no.'

dialogue.origin: 自分の興味のある話しか取り合わない感じで、昼ごはんその人が居ると息がつまるんです
dialogue.content: It feels like she only engages in conversations that interest her. When she's there during lunch, it feels suffocating.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですか・・。折角お話しようとしても、素っ気ない返事だと悲しくなりますよね。そのような空気の中でご飯を食べると、息が詰まりそうになるのも当然だと思います。
dialogue.content: I see... It must be disheartening when you try to talk, only to get a curt reply. It's completely understandable that eating in such an atmosphere would feel suffocating.

dialogue.origin: その人と同じ部署の事務員は何人入れても1年以内に辞めていきます。
dialogue.content: No matter how many administrative staff are hired in her department, they end up quitting within a year.

dialogue.origin: 仕事で話しかける時はキツい態度も慣れましたが、お昼まで勘弁してほしいです
dialogue.content: I've gotten used to her harsh attitude when I talk to her for work, but I wish she'd give me a break during lunch.

dialogue.origin: それほど皆さんがキツい性格だと感じられているんですね。お昼ごはんの時くらい、ゆっくりリラックスしたいですよね。
dialogue.content: So, it seems that everyone finds her personality that harsh. You must want to at least be able to relax during your lunch break.

dialogue.origin: その人も居心地は悪いんだと思うんですよねー食べたらさっさと出て行くんです。それなら雰囲気良くなるようにすればいいのに。自分が被害者だと思っているんですかねー
dialogue.content: I think she feels uncomfortable too. She leaves as soon as she finishes eating. If that's the case, you'd think she'd try to make the atmosphere better. I wonder if she thinks she's the victim.

dialogue.origin: そんな感じなのですね。ご自分で雰囲気を悪くしているのに、それを変えようともされていないのですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so that's how it is. She's creating this bad atmosphere herself but isn't trying to change it.

dialogue.origin: 他の職場の方とは、その方についてご相談されることはありますか。
dialogue.content: Do you ever talk about her with your other coworkers?

dialogue.origin: 2年くらい居た事務員が辞めた際には、同じ部署の人とその話の中で、その横の席である問題の彼女はキツいからねーとは話たりしてました。
dialogue.content: When an administrative staff member who had been there for about two years quit, I talked with people from her department, and we all mentioned how harsh the coworker in question is.

dialogue.origin: あと、事務員続かないので、社長やその奥さんに何でかなーとか相談されました。あの人キツいよねってお2人とも思ってるみたいでした
dialogue.content: Also, because administrative staff don't stay, the company president and his wife asked me why that might be. It seemed both of them thought, 'She's harsh, isn't she?'

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。同じ部署の方がどんどん辞めるほど、他の職場の方もあなたと同じようにキツい思いをされているんですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So much so that people in her department keep quitting, it seems your other coworkers are having a hard time with her, just like you are.

dialogue.origin: あなたとは部署が違うとのことでしたが、日々どのくらい仕事で関わっていらっしゃるんですか。
dialogue.content: You mentioned you're in different departments; how often do you interact with her for work on a daily basis?

dialogue.origin: 私の部署の人に郵便物を出してとか、社印もらって来てと言われて、事務所行った際に、他の事務員居なければ、その人にお願いするくらいですが、どうもうちの部署の人も事務所行きたくないのか、自分で出来る場合でも頼って来られるので･･･仕事なので行きますが。
dialogue.content: People in my department ask me to mail things or get the company seal, and when I go to the office and no other admin staff are there, I have to ask her. It seems people in my department don't want to go to the office either, so they ask me even when they could do it themselves... I go because it's part of my job, though.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ、そうなんですね。あなたは仕事への責任感も強いように思いますので、頼られると断りづらいですよね。でも、本当はご自身も事務所に行きたくないので、ストレスを抱えてしまいますよね。
dialogue.content: Yes, I see. It sounds like you have a strong sense of responsibility, so it must be hard to refuse when people ask you. But in reality, you don't want to go to the office either, which must be stressful for you.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。社長や奥さんに聞かれた時、周りに同じ部署の人居たので、誤魔化して本心言えませんでした
dialogue.content: That's right. When the president and his wife asked me, there were people from her department around, so I dodged the question and couldn't say what I really felt.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね・・。本心を言えないのは苦しいですよね。
dialogue.content: I see... It must be painful not being able to say what you truly feel.

dialogue.origin: 先ほど、仕事に関しては慣れたけどお昼ご飯の時までは勘弁してほしい、とのことでしたが、今のあなたの一番の悩みはお昼ご飯の時間でしょうか。
dialogue.content: You mentioned earlier that you've gotten used to dealing with her for work, but you wish she would give you a break during lunch. Is your biggest concern right now the lunchtime period?

dialogue.origin: 本心言うと、話のニュアンスとか変わって本人の耳に入ったりすることもあるので
dialogue.content: To be honest, nuances can change as a story gets passed around, and it could get back to her.

dialogue.origin: 一番の悩みはお昼ご飯中の雰囲気ですね
dialogue.content: My biggest concern is the atmosphere during lunch.

dialogue.origin: 食べない事も1つの方法ですが、そうなると余計に話づらくなり関係悪化しそうな気がするんですよね
dialogue.content: Not eating there is one option, but I feel like that would make it even harder to talk to her and might worsen our relationship.

dialogue.origin: 確かに、人づてにどのように伝わるか分からない不安もありますよね。
dialogue.content: That's true, there's the anxiety of not knowing how things will be relayed through others.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ、あなたは既にどうすればいいか色々と考え悩まれてきたのですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, yes, it sounds like you've already thought a lot about what to do and have been struggling with this.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね？なんかそんなつもりじゃなかったのにとか、日和見主義者も居ますし･･･人を疑うのはよくないですが
dialogue.content: Right? Things can get twisted, and there are opportunists... I know it's not good to be suspicious of people, but...

dialogue.origin: はい、もう一年以上悩んで、いろいろ努力しても、向こうの気分1つで関係悪化
dialogue.content: Yes, I've been struggling for over a year, and despite my efforts, the relationship worsens at the mercy of her mood.

dialogue.origin: 一年以上も悩まれてきたのですね・・。あなたはずっと努力されてきたのに、それが報われないのは苦しいですね・・。
dialogue.content: You've been grappling with this for over a year... It's painful when you've been trying so hard and your efforts aren't rewarded.

dialogue.origin: では、お昼ごはんの時に少しでも気持ちがラクになれるように、一緒に考えたいと思いますがよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Then, would it be alright if we think together about ways to make lunchtime feel a little easier for you?

dialogue.origin: 前に楽しそうに喋っておられた時と雰囲気悪い時を比較して、自分には原因は何も思い当たらない。郵便物お願いしたくらいです。その日その方忙しかったのか、イライラした返答でしたが、それは私のせいでは無いので、結局、私何も悪くないんだと思いました
dialogue.content: Comparing the times she seemed to be talking happily and the times the atmosphere was bad, I can't think of anything I did to cause it. The only thing was asking her to handle some mail. Maybe she was busy that day, because her reply was irritated, but that's not my fault. So, in the end, I realized I haven't done anything wrong.

dialogue.origin: お願いいたします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: 自分では何も思い当たらないのに、雰囲気悪い時があると、不安になるし、キツいですよね。でも、ご自身が原因ではないということに、気付かれたんですね。
dialogue.content: When the atmosphere turns bad and you can't think of anything you've done, it's tough and makes you anxious. But you've realized that it's not your fault.

dialogue.origin: お昼ごはんの時間は、必ずその方と一緒の部屋で同じ時間に食べるのですか？
dialogue.content: During lunchtime, do you always have to eat in the same room at the same time as her?

dialogue.origin: はい。今まで、私の言動に問題あるのかとか、負い目あったけど違うと気づきまひた
dialogue.content: Yes. Until now, I felt guilty, wondering if there was a problem with my words or actions, but I realized that's not it.

dialogue.origin: 部屋は女性みんな一緒ですが、コロナで過密にならないように、私だけ15分ずらして遅れて入ります
dialogue.content: All the women are in the same room, but to avoid crowding due to COVID, I go in 15 minutes later than everyone else.

dialogue.origin: その気づきはとても大切な気づきだと思います。あなたは「自分が悪い訳ではない」ということに気づいてどのように感じられましたか。
dialogue.content: I think that is a very important realization. How did you feel when you realized that 'it's not your fault'?

dialogue.origin: なので一緒なのは15分くらいですが、無言なのも感じ悪いし、喋れば、鬱陶しい感じの返事されるし、どうしていいかわからないんです
dialogue.content: So we're only together for about 15 minutes, but being silent feels awkward, and if I talk, I get an annoyed-sounding reply. I just don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: ちょっとホッとしました
dialogue.content: I felt a bit relieved.

dialogue.origin: 冷静を保てる様になりました
dialogue.content: I've become able to stay calm.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そうなんですね。無言で食事するのは息苦しいですよね。他の方とはお話しながらお食事されているのですか。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, I see. Eating in silence must be stifling. Do you talk with the other women while you eat?

dialogue.origin: ほっとしたり、冷静になれたり、その気持ちにご自身でなれたことは、あなたがずっと悩まれてきたからこそだと思います。
dialogue.content: Feeling relieved and being able to stay calm—I believe you were able to reach those feelings on your own precisely because you've been grappling with this for so long.

dialogue.origin: もう1人の女性は歳離れて若く、無言でスマホ見て食べてます。話しかければ答えてくれるんですが。もう1人、歳の近い方とは楽しく話すことが出来るんですが、週1日お休みなので、その日がとても息苦しいです
dialogue.content: There's another woman who is much younger, and she eats in silence while looking at her phone. She'll answer if I talk to her, though. There's one other person closer to my age who I can enjoy talking with, but she's off one day a week, and that day is very stifling.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。一年くらい寝苦しい時もありました
dialogue.content: That's right. For about a year, there were times when I had trouble sleeping.

dialogue.origin: 一緒にお話しできる方がいると心が安らぎますよね。その方がいない１日がとても苦しいのですね。
dialogue.content: It must be comforting to have someone you can talk to. That one day when she isn't there must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: それほどずっと深く悩まれてきたんですね・・。あなたは、週に一回の辛いお昼ご飯の時間がどのようになればいいいな、と思われますか。
dialogue.content: You've been struggling with this so deeply for so long... How would you like that difficult, once-a-week lunchtime to be?

dialogue.origin: そーですね、私もバイトなので休みたいです。話しやすい方入社半年くらいで、まだ本当に腹割ってお話してないんですが、信用出来そうではあるので、何かの機会に、昼の雰囲気とかどう思ってるか聞いてみたいとは思っています。
dialogue.content: Well, I'm a part-timer myself, so I'd like to take a day off too. The person who is easy to talk to has only been with the company for about six months, and while we haven't really had a heart-to-heart yet, she seems trustworthy. I've been thinking I'd like to ask her what she thinks of the lunchtime atmosphere when I get the chance.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ、そう思われるんですね。入社半年の方と話をしてみることで、お昼ごはんの時間がもっと良い雰囲気になるよう、一緒に考えることもできるかもしれないですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, I see that's what you're thinking. By talking with the colleague who's been there for six months, you might be able to think together about how to create a better lunchtime atmosphere.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、でもその方休みの日はどうしようもないんですよね。私も無言で食べた方がいいんですかねー？
dialogue.content: That's true, but there's nothing I can do on the day she's off. Maybe I should just eat in silence too?

dialogue.origin: それも一つの方法かと思います。先ほどあなたが仰っていたように、あなたは特に悪いことをしていないのですから、もし可能であれば、割り切って一人の時間を楽しむというのもいいのかと思いますが、いかがでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I think that's one option. As you said earlier, you haven't done anything wrong, so if it's possible, perhaps it would be good to try to accept it and enjoy the time by yourself. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 無言で気まずく感じてるのは私一人なのかもしれないですね。皆さん静かに食べたいのかもしれないですね。これは私の思い込みかもしれないです。それが鬱陶しいのかもしれないし
dialogue.content: Maybe I'm the only one who feels awkward about the silence. Perhaps everyone else just wants to eat quietly. This might be my own assumption. And maybe that's what's annoying to them.

dialogue.origin: 確かにそうですね。無理に話し出してる感じが鬱陶しいと思われてる可能性ありますね
dialogue.content: That's true. It's possible she finds it annoying that it feels like I'm forcing conversation.

dialogue.origin: 話たくないから食べたらさっさとその人席を立つんですよね
dialogue.content: That must be why she leaves her seat as soon as she finishes eating—because she doesn't want to talk.

dialogue.origin: 「無言で気まずく感じる」というのは、あなたが他の方に配慮できる優しい方だからだと思いますよ。
dialogue.content: The fact that you 'feel awkward in silence' just shows that you are a kind and considerate person.

dialogue.origin: でもそれであなたが苦しく感じるのであれば、１人の時間だと割り切ってみるのもいいのかもしれません。
dialogue.content: But if it's causing you distress, it might be good to try to see it as your own time.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。でも自分の居心地の悪さなんですよね
dialogue.content: Thank you. But it's my own discomfort that's the issue.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、ご自身が居心地悪いと感じてしまうのが悩みですものね。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, the problem is that you yourself feel uncomfortable.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、暫く無言で食べてみて様子みるのもいいかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: You're right, it might be a good idea to try eating in silence for a while and see how it goes.

dialogue.origin: その通りですね
dialogue.content: That's exactly right.

dialogue.origin: はい、一度試してみるのも良いかと思います。
dialogue.content: Yes, I think it might be good to give it a try.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 本日は終了のお時間となりましたが、また悩みが続くようであれば、またいつでもご相談にきてくださいね。
dialogue.content: Our time for today is up, but if you continue to struggle with this, please feel free to come back for another consultation anytime.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 本日はご相談にきていただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.origin: （貴重なお時間をいただきありがとうございました。時間を超過してしまい申し訳ございません。終了メッセージを送らせていただいてよろしいでしょうか？）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your valuable time. I apologize for running over our scheduled time. May I send the closing message?)

dialogue.origin: はい、よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Yes, please do.

topic.sub: 同僚とのコミュニケーションの悩み
